purpose: Fixed dev subset for fast iteration on the Planner-Executor-Reviewer increments. Baseline = deepseek-v4-flash, 接法B.
baseline_overall: resolved 26/50=0.52; this subset baseline below covers the dominant failure modes for both increments
composition: 5 confident-wrong(②) fails + 1 missed-second-file(②+①, Planner target) + 3 resolved(regression) + 1 sphinx hard(③) = 10 core; +2 optional stress (1 sphinx empty-thrash, 1 missed-file cross-data-flow)
note_cost: core 10 single-pass ~2.1M tok, dominated by sphinx-8548(1.41M). The cheap 9 (~680k) suit frequent loops; run the hard ③ less often.
note_planner: django-12325 added 2026-06-03 as the clean missed-file (②+①) representative so the subset can measure the Planner's value on multi-site fixes. Rationale: gold edits BOTH django/db/models/base.py (add `field.remote_field.parent_link` guard) AND django/db/models/options.py (remove the ImproperlyConfigured raise); the bug cannot be fixed by either edit alone. Baseline agent edited only base.py and stopped — the textbook 'fixed the main site, missed the coordinated second site' miss the Planner is meant to prevent. Chosen over the other 4 partials because it is the cheapest (144k tok, 13 tools) and smallest gold (35 lines) clean 1/2-file miss; the sphinx partials (10673=1.91M, 7590=707k & misses 2/3) are too expensive/hard for the fast loop, and django-11885 (801k, 213-line gold) is far costlier. django-12406 (the second-cheapest, a cross-file producer/consumer miss) is parked in optional_stress.

core.reason: 便宜快错典范:18s/7工具找到根因(模板引擎把enum当可调用),改一处自信宣布完成、实则错;Reviewer若复核'真满足issue吗'最该救这类
最便宜的django自信改错(27k/7工具),快循环成本低、信号干净
已知根因:patch把maxlength写成str(254)→类型不匹配测试失败;Reviewer查'类型/取值是否符合预期'即可发现,是Reviewer的理想正样本
最便宜的sphinx自信改错(29k/5工具/12s),让子集含sphinx的②但不拖慢循环
sphinx中等成本②(64k/10工具/20s),补充sphinx侧的逻辑失败样本

Planner 的干净正样本(漏改多文件):MTI 多个 OneToOne 时 pk 选错。gold 必须同时改两处——base.py 给 OneToOneField 循环加 `field.remote_field.parent_link` 守卫 + options.py 删掉 ImproperlyConfigured 抛出;缺任一处都修不好。baseline agent 只改了 base.py 就收工(漏 options.py),正是'修了主点、漏了配套第二点'。在5个 partial 里最便宜最干净(144k/13工具,gold仅35行,1/2文件漏改),适合快循环测 Planner 治漏改的价值。
最便宜的已解出题(11k/3工具/7s),回归哨兵:Reviewer改动不能把它弄挂
便宜已解出(19k/5工具),第二个django回归哨兵
最便宜的sphinx已解出(22k/12s),确保Reviewer不破坏sphinx侧已对的题
sphinx不收敛代表(撞50轮上限,1.41M token):看Reviewer/Planner能否约束thrash边界;成本高,建议低频跑

optional_stress.reason: 极端:空patch、2.3M token撞上限;可选压力题,默认不入快循环(太贵)

第二个漏改代表(跨文件 producer/consumer 型),成本较高故入可选压力题、低频跑。RadioSelect 外键不应给 blank=False 的字段显示空选项。gold 改两处且耦合更松:related.py 的 formfield() 把 `blank=self.blank` 传下去(producer),forms/models.py 的 ModelChoiceField 接收 blank 并据此抑制 empty_label(consumer)。baseline 只改了 forms/models.py、漏 related.py。比 12325 贵(788k/31工具,baseline 偏 thrashy),用来压测 Planner 能否追踪跨文件数据流、而非只定位单点。
